title: View Enrolled Courses
course_scope_description: Own MCeLE course listings, statuses, common self-paced actions and records. No staff management of another user records or course eligibility rules.
content:
Use this guidance to find your own MCeLE courses, check their status, and understand common self-paced course actions.

### Find your courses

1. Select **Student Dashboard** in the left navigation menu.
2. Select **My Courses**.
3. Find the course. You can sort newest or oldest, or filter by course type, status, or category.

Courses can show statuses such as Pending, In Progress, Completed, Incomplete, Enrolled, Disenrolled, Passed, Failed, or Equivalency.

### Common course actions

- **Launch:** Opens the course enrollment page, where you can access the associated self-paced course material, tests, or surveys.
- **View:** Reviews completed-course content. Selecting View does not enroll you in the course again. If you want to take a completed course again, use the applicable re-enrollment guidance.
- **Download Certificate:** View, download, or print a course certificate or diploma.
- **Disenroll:** Disenroll from the course.
- **Details:** Open the dropdown under the course title to see the description and ACE, CEU, and RRC credit amounts.
- **Sub-Courses:** Open the dropdown under a curriculum title to see its associated sub-courses.

Use the actions available for the course and its current status.

### Transcripts

Select **Request Official Transcript** in the top right for a transcript going to a college or employer. Select **Print Transcript** for an unofficial transcript.
